read.en: Corning fell 1.7% on Oct 15 to $138.43 on volume 1.5 times its 20-day average and is down 9% in five sessions. It is below all its averages: the 5-day ($146.4), 10-day ($154.0), falling 30-day ($154.8), 200-day ($153.4) and falling 100-day ($167.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($167.2), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 康宁 10月15日下跌 1.7%，收于 $138.43，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.5 倍，五个交易日下跌 9%。股价位于所有均线下方：5 日（$146.4）、10 日（$154.0）、下行的 30 日（$154.8）、200 日（$153.4）以及下行的 100 日均线（$167.7）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$167.2），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The Sep 3 low ($139.25), the last support above $114.5, broke on the close after a day's low of $132.75. It now caps at $139.3, then $141.6–142.4 (Aug 24 and Sep 16 lows) and $146.4 (5-day average). Support is $132.75 (Oct 15 low), then $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close below $132.75 would open $114.5; a close back above $142.4 would target $146.4.
